units.source_text: 那么，这一个个的小部分究竟是什么呢？

en.t: Then what exactly are each of these little parts?
At times, I too had pondered it.

units.source_text: 然而，这些发光的七零八落的断片，比在路旁闪光的啤酒瓶碎片更缺乏意义，更欠缺规律性。

en.t: However, these shining, scattered fragments had even less meaning and even less regularity than shards of beer bottles glittering by the roadside.
